missBART: joint models for non-ignorable missing responses using BART

Source: R/missBART-package.R
missBART-package.Rd

The main functions are missBART1(), missBART2() and mvBART(). See Goh, Soh, Parnell and Murphy (2024) doi:10.48550/arXiv.2412.14946.
